units.source_text: 僵硬的脸像抹过浆糊，呼吸达风速二十米，

en.t: His stiff face felt as if it had been smeared with paste, and his breathing reached the force of a twenty-meter wind,

units.source_text: 唾液里带着干燥、焦糊的砂糖滋味……

en.t: while his saliva carried the dry, scorched taste of burnt sugar...

units.source_text: 至少有一杯水，变成汗蒸发掉了。

en.t: At least a cup of water had turned into sweat and evaporated away.

units.source_text: 女人低着头，慢慢地爬起来。

en.t: The woman kept her head lowered and slowly crawled to her feet.

units.source_text: 她那沾满沙子的头，正好和男人的眼睛一般高。

en.t: Her sand-covered head was just level with the man's eyes.

units.source_text: 突然，她擤起鼻涕来，然后，捧起一把沙子，

en.t: Suddenly, she blew her nose, then scooped up a handful of sand,
and, using it instead of paper, rubbed her hands together.

units.source_text: 从女人弯着的腰上，劳动裤唰地滑落下来。

en.t: From the woman's bent waist, her work trousers slid down with a swift rustle.
